reviewSamples.author: Photo of Kat Reid
reviewSamples.text: So friendly and knowledgeable. One of the best massages I've ever had. Julia has a true gift of knowing exactly what you need. While she encouraged communication, I didn’t have to say anything because her pressure level and attention to areas needing extra work or spot on! Can’t wait for my next massage!
